title: Suspicious Poison
summary: Poison disguised as a healing potion, with distinct drink and throw effects.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. DC 13 Constitution save. On failure take 3d6 Poison and gain the special Poisoned for up to 10 turns. Reattempt the save at round end to remove it.
fields.Throw: Action. A 3-ft-radius Poison Cloud lasts 1 turn and deals 3d6 Poison to creatures inside. The item source reports a 3-turn status and a separate DC 13 Constitution status for 1 round. The same source describes the damaging status as lasting up to 10 turns.
fields.Recurring poison: DC 13 Constitution at turn start or take 3d6 Poison. A successful save ends the recurring damage. It cannot coat weapons. It can be mixed with the Grymforge beer barrel to poison the duergar harassing Skickpit.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
